subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

The supermarket is open from __10 a.m.__ __still 10 p.m.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**still**" instead of "**till**" or "**until**."
 
• The word "**still**" is not appropriate in this context as it implies continuity rather than a time range.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**from 10 a.m. till 10 p.m.**" or "**from 10 a.m. until 10 p.m.**" ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The supermarket is open from **10 a.m. till 10 p.m.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "open"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "from 10 a.m."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "The supermarket"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
